title: feat(nmreadopp): neighbor-read of M on #7208: reverse UNDEFINED, face UNDEFINED
science: FORCING NEGATIVE on locality of readout. Neighbour-read R of the probe's incoming set on #7208's y-probes: read=fail at all four probes, R is empty at A and C (so both bits are UNDEFINED) and R != M everywhere, e.g. R(B) is a single letter against M(B)={+e1} and R(D) is a single letter against a three-element M(D). Recomputed and confirmed. Paired with #7205 this closes a pincer: the reverse relat
